about: The Undying Dirge: lore and the ten night rites every city must finish to be freed, different in every city (rites, by town). Rite types: slay (n risen in the city), wards (light n braziers round the shrine), order (light the braziers at the compass points in the order given, letters N E S W), relics (find n tokens hidden round the city), circle (keep the dead out of the shrine's ritual circle for n seconds; it resets if they swarm it), hold (stand at the shrine n seconds), champion (hunt a named champion: the champion row is its kind, championHealth its health in zombies' night health), herald (the night's boss in the fog). Progress lives in one global per city (step*1000 + progress), saved with the game. {city} is filled per city, {n} with the target. A freed city is a sanctuary: no undead rise within zoneRadius of its station or in its own location; its shout waits at the shrine.
prologue: Helgen burned, and you lived. But as the World-Eater rose from the ash he sang a word older than the Thu'um: the Undying Dirge. Every grave in Skyrim heard it. Now when the sun goes down, the dead claw their way up to finish what he began. The Dirge has taken root in the cities of the holds. Break it, city by city, and their dead will sleep again.
liftedText: The Dirge's root beneath {city} shatters. Its dead sleep again: no undead will rise within its bounds.
freedAll: Every city of Skyrim stands free of the Dirge. Its echo lingers only in the wild places, and it will not fall silent until the World-Eater does.

rows.title: The Ashen Tithe
rows.text: The dead of {city} rise thickest near {landmark}, drawn to the Dirge like moths to a flame. Every one you put back in the ground loosens the curse's grip on the city. Slay {n} of the risen within {city}'s bounds.

rows.title: The Ward-Fires of {city}
rows.goal: Light the ward-fires around the shrine
rows.text: Long ago the priests of {city} kept three ward-fires burning against the restless dead, until the Dirge snuffed them out. Three cold braziers now stand around your shrine. Stand by each one until it catches, and keep the dead off you while it does.

rows.title: The Vigil of {city}
rows.text: The curse's root lies beneath {city}'s shrine. Stand your ground there while the night throws everything it has at you. Hold the shrine for {n} seconds and the root will crack.

rows.title: The Herald in the Fog
rows.goal: Slay the Herald of the Dirge
rows.text: Its root cracked, the Dirge calls its Herald: Grimmvar, the Undying Wyrm, who walks only in fog. The next night you face in {city}, the fog will roll in and the Herald will come for you. Slay it before dawn and the city is free.

Riverwood.title: The Scattered Bones
Riverwood.text: When the Dirge first sang, Riverwood's old dead were torn from Bleak Falls Barrow and scattered. Four grave-tokens still smoulder where they fell. Grab them before the dead do.

Riverwood.title: Blood on the River
Riverwood.text: The dead come looking for what you took. Put {n} of them back in the ground before they reach the mill.

Riverwood.title: Lanterns of the Mill
Riverwood.text: Hod swears the dead won't cross a lit lantern. Three cold ones hang round your shrine. Stand by each until it catches - and keep your back covered.

Riverwood.title: Alvor's Anvil
Riverwood.text: Alvor is forging silver for the village with the forge-door barred. Hold the shrine for {n} seconds so the hammer never stops.

Riverwood.title: Lucan's Golden Claw
Riverwood.text: The Dirge cracked the Golden Claw's shadow in three and hid the pieces round the village. Lucan will pay - if you live. Find all three.

Riverwood.title: The Guardian Stones Watch
Riverwood.text: The Warrior, the Mage and the Thief are watching. Show them what you are: {n} more dead, no running.

Riverwood.title: The Barrow Rite
Riverwood.goal: Keep the dead out of the ritual circle
Riverwood.text: The shrine's circle can bind the barrow shut, but only if no dead thing crosses it while it burns. Keep them out for {n} seconds. If they swarm it, it starts again.

Riverwood.title: Faendal's Arrows
Riverwood.goal: Kindle the braziers where the arrows fell
Riverwood.text: Faendal loosed four fire-arrows into the night - NORTH, then WEST, then SOUTH, then EAST. Light the braziers where they landed, in that order, or the dead hear you.

Riverwood.title: The Last Wave
Riverwood.text: The barrow is emptying itself into the river. Break the last wave: {n} dead.

Riverwood.title: The Barrow-Lord
Riverwood.text: Bound out of his barrow, the Barrow-Lord walks Riverwood himself. Find Hrothgar in the night and end him.

Whiterun.title: Kyne's Watchfires
Whiterun.text: Four watchfires once burned for Kyne round the Plains District. Stand by each until it catches, and keep the dead off you while it does.

Whiterun.title: Trouble at the Drunken Huntsman
Whiterun.text: Elrindir has locked the door and is shooting through the window. Help him thin them out: {n} dead.

Whiterun.title: The Sun's Road
Whiterun.goal: Kindle the braziers as the sun travels
Whiterun.text: Kyne's priests lit their fires the way the sun walks: first EAST, then SOUTH at noon, then WEST, and NORTH last in the dark. Light them out of order and the dead will answer.

Whiterun.title: The Gildergreen's Sap
Whiterun.text: Danica says the Gildergreen bled when the Dirge began. Four drops of its sap glow somewhere in the city. Bring them home.

Whiterun.title: Skyforge Ringing
Whiterun.text: Eorlund is quenching a blade on the Skyforge and won't stop for the dead. Hold the shrine {n} seconds while the forge rings.

Whiterun.title: Companions' Hunt
Whiterun.text: Aela has called a hunt, and you're the bait. {n} dead before the horn sounds.

Whiterun.title: Dragonsreach's Shadow
Whiterun.goal: Keep the dead out of the warding circle
Whiterun.text: The court wizard's circle needs one clean minute. Keep every dead thing out of it for {n} seconds.

Whiterun.title: The Ash-Skald
Whiterun.text: A dead bard of Jorrvaskr sings the Dirge in the streets, and the dead dance to it. Shut him up for good.

Whiterun.title: The Plains Burn
Whiterun.text: The tundra's dead march on the gates. {n} more and the Plains District holds.

Whiterun.title: The Herald in the Fog
Whiterun.goal: Slay the Herald of the Dirge
Whiterun.text: Whiterun has seen dragons fall. Tonight it watches you. The Dirge sends its Herald out of the fog: whatever great horror walks this night. Slay it before dawn and {city} is free.

Solitude.title: The Hangman's Dead
Solitude.text: Everyone who swung from Solitude's gallows has climbed back down. Put {n} of them in the ground for good.

Solitude.title: Lamps of the Bards College
Solitude.text: Viarmo wants the college lamps lit before the Dirge's song drowns out the students. Three lamps, three verses, no dead.

Solitude.title: Bones of the Wolf Queen
Solitude.text: Potema's bones were scattered so she could never rise again. The Dirge is gathering them. Find five pieces before it does.

Solitude.title: The Blue Palace Gate
Solitude.text: Jarl Elisif has sealed the palace. Prove the gate never needed to close: hold the shrine {n} seconds.

Solitude.title: The Arch at Dusk
Solitude.goal: Kindle the braziers as the Arch lights
Solitude.text: The lamps along the great Arch are lit from the sea up: WEST, NORTH, EAST, SOUTH. Follow the old lamplighter's path.

Solitude.title: East Empire Docks
Solitude.text: Drowned sailors are crawling out of the harbour. {n} of them, and the cargo is safe.

Solitude.title: Potema's Last Thrall
Solitude.text: Her last thrall still serves her and raises the dead in her name. Destroy it.

Solitude.title: The Emperor's Seals
Solitude.text: Three imperial seals were lost when Castle Dour's dead broke loose. Find them before the Legion notices.

Solitude.title: The Queen's Requiem
Solitude.goal: Keep the dead out of the requiem circle
Solitude.text: Sing her down. The priests' circle must burn for {n} seconds with no dead inside it. If they break it, it starts again.

Solitude.title: The Herald in the Fog
Solitude.goal: Slay the Herald of the Dirge
Solitude.text: Potema's shadow is broken. Only her master is left. The Dirge sends its Herald out of the fog: whatever great horror walks this night. Slay it before dawn and {city} is free.

Windhelm.title: The Five Hundred's Fires
Windhelm.goal: Kindle the braziers in Ysgramor's order
Windhelm.text: Ysgramor's companions lit their fires from the sea: NORTH where the ships came in, then EAST, then SOUTH, then WEST. Keep their order or the dead come.

Windhelm.title: The Grey Quarter's Dead
Windhelm.text: The dead are thick in the narrow streets. Slay {n} of them before they reach the Cornerclub.

Windhelm.title: The Butcher's Trophies
Windhelm.text: Somebody - something - is collecting pieces of Windhelm's dead again. Four grisly trophies are hidden round the city. Find them.

Windhelm.title: Candlehearth Flames
Windhelm.text: Elda swears the Candlehearth's flame has burned since the city was built. Carry it to three cold braziers round your shrine.

Windhelm.title: The Frozen Docks
Windhelm.text: The dead are walking across the frozen river. Break {n} of them on the ice.

Windhelm.title: Stand at Ysgramor's Shrine
Windhelm.text: Stand your ground at the shrine while the night throws everything at you. Hold it for {n} seconds.

Windhelm.title: The Palace of the Kings
Windhelm.goal: Keep the dead out of the royal circle
Windhelm.text: Ulfric's housecarls have drawn a circle in salt. Keep it clean of dead for {n} seconds.

Windhelm.title: Ysgramor's Teeth
Windhelm.text: Three fragments of an old war-horn lie scattered round the city. Together they could still make the dead flinch.

Windhelm.title: The White River Rises
Windhelm.text: The river gives up its dead all at once. {n} more and Windhelm stands.

Windhelm.title: The Frost-Jarl
Windhelm.text: A jarl of the old Kings walks again, frozen and furious. Find Hrolvar in the night and break him.

Markarth.title: The Tonal Keys
Markarth.text: Five Dwemer tonal keys lie about the city. Together they can tune the old resonator against the Dirge. Find them.

Markarth.title: The Warrens' Dead
Markarth.text: The Warrens' poor were buried in the rock, and now they're climbing out. Lay {n} of them to rest.

Markarth.title: Steam Vents of the Dwemer
Markarth.text: Old Dwemer vents can scald the dead off the stairways. Wake three of them - stand close, it takes a moment.

Markarth.title: The Tonal Resonator
Markarth.goal: Keep the dead out of the resonator's circle
Markarth.text: The resonator hums at your shrine. Keep the dead out of its circle for {n} seconds while it tunes the stone against the Dirge.

Markarth.title: Cidhna Breakout
Markarth.text: The dead of Cidhna Mine have broken their chains. Put {n} of them back underground.

Markarth.title: The Forsworn Totems
Markarth.goal: Kindle the totems in the Reach order
Markarth.text: The Forsworn burn their totems SOUTH to NORTH, then EAST to WEST. Get it wrong and the Reach itself answers.

Markarth.title: The Hall of the Dead
Markarth.text: Brother Verulus is sealing the catacombs. Hold the shrine {n} seconds and not one more corpse leaves the Hall.

Markarth.title: The Witch-Bones
Markarth.text: A briarheart witch, long dead, raises the Reach's dead against the city. Destroy her.

Markarth.title: Silver-Blood Debt
Markarth.text: Thonar Silver-Blood is paying in silver for every corpse. Collect: {n} dead.

Markarth.title: The Herald in the Fog
Markarth.goal: Slay the Herald of the Dirge
Markarth.text: The stone city has gone quiet. Something enormous is listening. The Dirge sends its Herald out of the fog: whatever great horror walks this night. Slay it before dawn and {city} is free.

Riften.title: Rats in the Ratway
Riften.text: The Ratway is crawling with the dead. Clear {n} of them before they reach the market.

Riften.title: Brynjolf's Mark
Riften.text: Brynjolf bets you can't lift four purses off the dead mid-fight. Prove him wrong - they're scattered round the city.

Riften.title: Mara's Candles
Riften.text: Maramal says the dead hate love more than fire. Light three of Mara's candles round your shrine.

Riften.title: The Nightingale's Shade
Riften.text: A Nightingale who failed her oath stalks the canals, fast as a knife. Catch her if you can.

Riften.title: The Bee and Barb
Riften.text: Keerava has bet the tavern you'll hold the shrine {n} seconds. Don't make her pay.

Riften.title: Honningbrew Dead
Riften.text: The canal is choked with drowned dead. Fish out {n} of them.

Riften.title: Nocturnal's Keys
Riften.text: Five keys of the Twilight Sepulcher are scattered round Riften. Nocturnal wants them back - and she'll return the favour.

Riften.title: The Black-Briar Ward
Riften.goal: Keep the dead out of the ward circle
Riften.text: Maven paid for this circle and expects results. Keep the dead out of it for {n} seconds.

Riften.title: The Canal Locks
Riften.goal: Open the locks in the right order
Riften.text: The canal locks open EAST, NORTH, WEST, SOUTH. Open them out of order and the dead flood in.

Riften.title: The Long Night
Riften.text: The darkest night Riften has known. Hold the shrine for {n} seconds and the Dirge's grip breaks.

Falkreath.title: Arkay's Grave-Candles
Falkreath.text: Runil keeps grave-candles for every soul in Falkreath's yard. Four have gone out. Light them.

Falkreath.title: The Graveyard Shift
Falkreath.text: The graveyard is emptying faster than Runil can bury. Help him: {n} dead.

Falkreath.title: The Restless Graves
Falkreath.text: The dead of {city} pulled up their own grave-markers. Find five and set them back.

Falkreath.title: Dead Man's Drink
Falkreath.text: Valga has promised a free round to whoever holds the shrine {n} seconds. Earn your mead.

Falkreath.title: The Tolling Order
Falkreath.goal: Kindle the braziers in the tolling order
Falkreath.text: Falkreath's funeral bell tolls SOUTH, WEST, NORTH, EAST. Kindle the braziers in that order and the dead must listen.

Falkreath.title: Hunters' Moon
Falkreath.text: The forest's dead are coming out of the pines. {n} more for the hunters' tally.

Falkreath.title: The Lone Coffin
Falkreath.goal: Keep the dead out of the vigil circle
Falkreath.text: A coffin nobody remembers burying sits in your circle. Keep the dead away from it for {n} seconds.

Falkreath.title: Dengeir's Secrets
Falkreath.text: The old jarl hid three letters about what really lies under the graveyard. Find them - quickly.

Falkreath.title: The Yard Overflows
Falkreath.text: Every grave is open at once. {n} dead and it's finally quiet.

Falkreath.title: The Gravewarden
Falkreath.text: The graveyard's first keeper has come back to keep it his way. Put the Gravewarden down.

Morthal.title: The Marsh Vigil
Morthal.goal: Keep the dead out of the vigil circle
Morthal.text: Keep the dead out of the vigil circle for {n} seconds while the marsh lights burn.

Morthal.title: Drowned Dead
Morthal.text: The marsh is giving up its drowned. Slay {n} of them before they reach the longhouses.

Morthal.title: Falion's Charms
Morthal.text: Falion hung four warding charms on the boardwalks, and the dead tore them down. Find them.

Morthal.title: Swamp-Lights
Morthal.text: Will-o'-the-wisps lead the dead astray. Light three swamp-lights round your shrine and let them wander.

Morthal.title: The Moorside Brawl
Morthal.text: Jonna has barricaded the Moorside and handed out cleavers. Help her break {n} dead.

Morthal.title: The Fog Bells
Morthal.goal: Ring the fog bells in order
Morthal.text: Morthal's fog bells ring NORTH, SOUTH, EAST, WEST. Ring them wrong and the marsh answers.

Morthal.title: Movarth's Blood-Thrall
Morthal.text: Movarth's last thrall hunts the boardwalks. Destroy it.

Morthal.title: Highmoon Hall
Morthal.text: Jarl Idgrod has seen this night in a vision: you, holding the shrine {n} seconds. Make it true.

Morthal.title: The Marsh Rises
Morthal.text: The whole marsh stands up at once. {n} more.

Morthal.title: The Herald in the Fog
Morthal.goal: Slay the Herald of the Dirge
Morthal.text: The fog thickens over the marsh. Something walks in it. The Dirge sends its Herald out of the fog: whatever great horror walks this night. Slay it before dawn and {city} is free.

Dawnstar.title: Shards of the Nightmare
Dawnstar.text: Five shards of Vaermina's nightmare lie frozen round the harbour. Gather them before the town sleeps again.

Dawnstar.title: Sleepless Dead
Dawnstar.text: The dead of {city} never got to sleep. Give {n} of them the rest they want.

Dawnstar.title: Harbour Beacons
Dawnstar.text: The ships are blind in the fog. Light three beacons round your shrine and bring them home.

Dawnstar.title: The Dreamer's Path
Dawnstar.goal: Kindle the braziers along the dreamer's path
Dawnstar.text: Erandur walks the dreamer's path: WEST, NORTH, EAST, SOUTH. Follow it exactly.

Dawnstar.title: The Iron-Breaker Mine
Dawnstar.text: Miners are climbing out of the Iron-Breaker who should never have gone in. {n} of them, now.

Dawnstar.title: Windpeak Inn
Dawnstar.text: Thoring has barred the inn and is pouring for anyone who holds the shrine {n} seconds.

Dawnstar.title: Vaermina's Hound
Dawnstar.text: Something with too many teeth prowls the frozen harbour. Hunt Vaermina's Hound.

Dawnstar.title: Skooma Dreams
Dawnstar.text: Three pouches of dream-salt went missing from the Nightcaller Temple. Whoever finds the dead holding them, finds them.

Dawnstar.title: The Long Dark
Dawnstar.text: The sun won't rise until {n} more are down.

Dawnstar.title: Wake the Town
Dawnstar.goal: Keep the dead out of the waking circle
Dawnstar.text: Keep the dead out of the waking circle for {n} seconds and Dawnstar wakes for good.

Winterhold.title: The Magnus Lights
Winterhold.text: Four lamps once burned with Magnus' light along the cliff. Light them again.

Winterhold.title: The Cliff Dead
Winterhold.text: The dead of drowned Winterhold climb the cliffs. Push {n} of them back into the sea.

Winterhold.title: Lost Pages of the College
Winterhold.text: Urag gro-Shub wants his pages back. Five of them blew across the town when the Dirge struck.

Winterhold.title: The Frozen Hearth
Winterhold.text: Dagur has kept the Frozen Hearth's fire going for days. Hold the shrine {n} seconds so he can sleep.

Winterhold.title: Apprentice Trouble
Winterhold.text: A college apprentice raised far more than he meant to. Clean up: {n} dead.

Winterhold.title: The Eye of Magnus
Winterhold.goal: Kindle the braziers as the Eye turned
Winterhold.text: The Eye of Magnus turned EAST, SOUTH, WEST, NORTH. Light the braziers the way it looked.

Winterhold.title: The Drowned Archmage
Winterhold.text: An Archmage lost with old Winterhold has walked out of the sea. Destroy him.

Winterhold.title: Arcanaeum Seal
Winterhold.goal: Keep the dead out of the sealing circle
Winterhold.text: Tolfdir's seal needs {n} seconds without a dead thing inside it.

Winterhold.title: The Great Collapse
Winterhold.text: Every soul lost in the Great Collapse is walking tonight. {n} more.

Winterhold.title: The Last Stand of Winterhold
Winterhold.text: Hold the shrine for {n} seconds. Winterhold has fallen before. Not tonight.
